Reading configuration through the default parameter env = process.env prevents Expo from inlining EXPO_PUBLIC_* values, so exported apps lack their connection settings despite passing injected-env Jest tests; use explicit process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_* references ([Expo documentation](https://docs.expo.dev/guides/environment-variables/)).

Task 9 deletes the only index route without creating a replacement or redirect, leaving the launch URL / unmatched while the revised unit smoke test bypasses routing by rendering the tab layout directly ([Expo routing documentation](https://docs.expo.dev/router/basics/core-concepts/)).

The new-user test creates a fresh identity but always claims the unique handle newbird without specifying cleanup, so a second contract-suite run against the same stack fails with a handle collision; generate a unique handle or remove the profile after the test.

The global Jest setup throws when .env.local is absent, but the separate checks CI job runs npm test without starting the stack or creating that file, so the required checks job fails on every fresh runner.

placeNotice must mirror NodePage queries against detections and its species relation, but Task 4's exhaustive interim schema omits those objects and seeds only mobile Listens, so the Place contract test cannot return the promised seeded species.

followPlace requires only sign-in although journal_follows references an existing listeners profile, and no task creates or claims that profile for new users, so their follows fail while the pre-profiled test user hides the defect.
